C1.worst_defect: Hero's second sentence leads with developer jargon, "the open-source headless commerce framework", before telling an owner what the till does at the counter; phone header shows only "Docs" and "Live demo"

C2.worst_defect: Refund row is honest but ends in jargon an owner cannot act on: "The refund stays Pending until an administrator settles it with two Admin API calls"
C2.where: home.desktop.02 (Live demo or your own store table)

C3.worst_defect: The email-plugin trap "If your store uses @vendure/email-plugin, swap its order-confirmation handler first" only appears at step 8 (sign in and sell), not in Before you start or before step 1

C4.worst_defect: Troubleshooting addresses "For the store owner: copy the refused line from this till's sync log, and match its errorCode" (register_session_already_open, register_closure_number_invalid) — developer work labelled as owner work, mixed with counter actions

C5.worst_defect: Cashier sheet and closure screenshots sit as small cards inside oversized empty frames, so the Z-report figures are hard to read

C6.worst_defect: Long inline code chips such as "N orders waiting to send" and "· sending…" force awkward mid-sentence line breaks on a phone

C7.worst_defect: og-image crops the till screenshot so "Add charge" is cut at the bottom edge; 404 page carries no JSON-LD (minor). Lighthouse 98/100/100/100, all endpoints 200, no overflow

overall_worst.defect: Troubleshooting tells the "store owner" to copy the refused line from the sync log and match its errorCode, and mixes GraphQL needs_admin steps with counter actions, so a non-developer owner cannot tell which steps are theirs and which belong to their developer
overall_worst.fix: Split each notice into an "At the counter" box with plain actions (what staff do now, whether the sale is safe) and a "For your developer" box holding errorCodes, sync-log lines and GraphQL; replace "store owner" with "whoever runs your Vendure server" wherever the step is technical
